d.ko: Start with nothing but a ticket booth in the mountains. Clear snow, chop wood, crack ice off rooftops, all by hand, all in first person. Serve drinks, cook meals, repair ski gear, and turn a rundown mountain stop into a full-blown resort with a hotel, restaurant, bar, and shop.

d.zh: 从山间一个简陋的售票亭起步。铲雪、劈柴、敲碎屋顶的冰块，一切亲力亲为，全程第一人称视角。调酒、烹饪、修理滑雪装备，将一个破旧的山间小站打造成拥有酒店、餐厅、酒吧和商店的度假胜地。
